title: Finance Lease — Commencement, Amortization, and Year-1 Entries (ASC 842)
scenario: On January 1, Year 1, Meridian Building Group (lessee) signs a 5-year lease for an excavator with an estimated useful life of 6 years. Annual payments of $60,000 are due each December 31. There is no transfer of ownership and no purchase option, and the excavator is not specialized. Meridian's incremental borrowing rate is 6% (the rate implicit in the lease is not readily determinable). Meridian pays $5,000 of initial direct costs at commencement. Use the chart of accounts in Exhibit B and round all amounts to the nearest dollar.

exhibits.label: Exhibit A — Lease terms and present-value factors

tasks.prompt: Requirement 1 — Classify this lease for Meridian and defend the classification against the ASC 842 lessee criteria.
tasks.explanation: The lease term (5 years) is 83% of the 6-year useful life, which is a major part (the commonly used 75% threshold), so this is a FINANCE lease even though ownership does not transfer, there is no purchase option, the asset is not specialized, and the PV test need not be reached.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 2 — Compute the initial lease liability at commencement.
tasks.explanation: $60,000 × PV ordinary annuity factor (6%, 5) 4.21236 = $252,742. Initial direct costs do NOT enter the liability.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 3 — Compute the initial right-of-use asset.
tasks.explanation: ROU asset = lease liability $252,742 + initial direct costs $5,000 = $257,742.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 4 — Record the January 1, Year 1 commencement entry (use account numbers from Exhibit B).
tasks.explanation: Dr ROU asset 257,742; Cr Lease liability 252,742; Cr Cash 5,000 for the initial direct costs paid at commencement.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 5 — For Year 1, compute interest expense, the reduction of the lease liability from the December 31 payment, and the ending lease liability.
Requirement 6 — Record the December 31, Year 1 payment entry (finance-lease treatment, account numbers from Exhibit B).
tasks.explanation: Dr Interest expense 15,165; Dr Lease liability 44,835; Cr Cash 60,000.

tasks.prompt: Requirement 7 — Compute Year-1 amortization of the ROU asset (finance lease, straight-line, no residual).
tasks.explanation: A finance-lease ROU asset with no ownership transfer amortizes over the SHORTER of lease term or useful life: $257,742 ÷ 5 = $51,548.
